title: Build an evidence set before synthesis
description: Choose a query, retrieval strategy, candidate count, and reranking policy. Watch recall, noise, context size, and latency move together.

queries.label: Current policy clause
queries.detail: Which refund rule applies to EU orders placed after 1 July?
queries.signal: Semantic meaning plus effective-date and region constraints

vector.reason: Meaning is found, but expired and out-of-region clauses remain candidates.

hybrid.reason: Exact date and region terms help, but metadata is still treated as text.

metadata-filtered.reason: Filters remove ineligible versions before semantic ranking.

queries.label: Exact error code
queries.detail: What causes checkout error PAY-1042 and how is it remediated?
queries.signal: An exact identifier plus explanatory prose

vector.reason: Related payment failures can outrank the exact identifier.

hybrid.reason: Lexical matching preserves the code while embeddings find the explanation.

metadata-filtered.reason: Filters help only if the error code is modeled as metadata.

queries.label: Cross-document comparison
queries.detail: Compare enterprise retention promises with the deletion runbook.
queries.signal: Broad semantic coverage across two source families

vector.reason: Semantic retrieval finds both themes when the candidate set is broad enough.

hybrid.reason: Fusion helps when both documents use shared operational terms.

metadata-filtered.reason: Source-family filters reduce noise but can hide one side if applied too narrowly.

strategies.label: Hybrid fusion
strategies.detail: Combine semantic and lexical candidate lists before synthesis.

strategies.label: Filter then retrieve
strategies.detail: Apply structured eligibility constraints before semantic ranking.
